newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE Coffee drifts down in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE Coffee drifts down in slow trade.

text.p: LIFFE coffee futures drifted down in quiet pre-holiday trading, traders said.
Volume was inflated by January-March and March-May spreads, and trade against actuals also boosted the apparent level of activity, they said.
Active March last traded $7 lower at $1,236 on volume of 1,476 lots. Total volume was 3,697 lots.
March had the biggest fall. The move down was bucked by November which last traded up $15 at $1,240, on volume of just 21 lots, and July, which last traded $3 higher at $1,216, on volume of 146 lots.
